name: Academics
description: Knowledge of history, literature, science, and scholarly pursuits. Used for research, teaching, or recalling obscure facts.

name: Athletics
description: Running, jumping, climbing, swimming, and other physical feats of coordination and endurance.

name: Battle
description: Commanding troops, understanding tactics, and leading forces effectively in combat.

name: Boating
description: Operating and navigating watercraft of all sizes, from canoes to large ships.

name: Common Knowledge
description: Everyday practical knowledge about the world, local customs, and general information.

name: Driving
description: Operating and maneuvering land vehicles such as cars, trucks, and tanks.

name: Electronics
description: Using, repairing, and understanding electronic devices, computers, and security systems.

name: Faith
description: Channeling divine power through belief and prayer.

name: Fighting
description: Hand-to-hand combat with fists, melee weapons, and natural attacks.

name: Focus
description: Maintaining concentration and control when using powers or resisting mental effects.

name: Gambling
description: Playing games of chance, reading opponents, and winning at cards or dice.

name: Hacking
description: Infiltrating, manipulating, and securing computer networks and digital systems.

name: Healing
description: Treating wounds, curing ailments, and providing medical care in the field.

name: Intimidation
description: Using threats, presence, or fear to coerce or demoralize others.

name: Language
description: Speaking, reading, and understanding foreign or ancient languages.

name: Notice
description: Spotting hidden details, ambushes, or important clues in the environment.

name: Occult
description: Knowledge of magic, supernatural creatures, rituals, and arcane lore.

name: Performance
description: Singing, acting, playing music, or entertaining an audience.

name: Persuasion
description: Convincing, negotiating, or charming others through words and charisma.

name: Piloting
description: Operating aircraft, spaceships, or other flying vehicles.

name: Psionics
description: Harnessing mental powers and psychic abilities.

name: Repair
description: Fixing mechanical devices, vehicles, and broken equipment.

name: Research
description: Finding information in libraries, databases, or ancient tomes.

name: Riding
description: Riding and controlling mounts such as horses or exotic beasts.

name: Science
description: Understanding natural laws, experiments, and advanced scientific principles.

name: Shooting
description: Firing ranged weapons such as guns, bows, or thrown objects.

name: Spellcasting
description: Channeling arcane energy to cast spells and manipulate magic.

name: Stealth
description: Moving silently, hiding, and avoiding detection.

name: Survival
description: Navigating the wilderness, foraging, tracking, and enduring harsh environments.

name: Taunt
description: Insulting or mocking opponents to provoke, distract, or demoralize them.

name: Thievery
description: Picking locks, pickpocketing, and other acts of sleight-of-hand and stealthy crime.

name: Weird Science
description: Inventing and operating bizarre, mad-science gadgets and contraptions.
